2609.35540.title: Continuous Context Management
2609.35540.paper_summary: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents commonly retain their complete interaction history until compaction is triggered at a predefined threshold. We study Continuous Context Management (CCM), which performs compaction at every turn to prevent interaction history from accumulating in the active prompt. At each turn, a CCM agent emits an updated memory together with an environment action; its next prompt contains the original task, retained memory, and newest observation rather than the complete transcript. We first evaluate CCM without fine-tuning on TerminalBench-2 using Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, GLM-5, and Kimi K3. CCM substantially reduces cumulative input usage and active-prompt size, although it lowers task success for most models while preserving performance for Kimi K3. We use GRPO with privileged full-history distillation to improve CCM in open-weight models. A frozen copy of the student's initial model scores each sampled student action under the complete history reconstructed from that student's rollout, providing dense action-token supervision without a separate teacher rollout or reference solution. On WebShop, this objective substantially improves CCM over GRPO at both evaluated model scales and surpasses full-history GRPO for Qwen3-4B-Instruct, though not for Qwen3-8B. On Endless Terminals, the augmented method provides a modest improvement over GRPO, with both CCM policies outperforming the untrained full-history baseline. These results demonstrate that CCM is a viable inference paradigm for agents operating with substantially reduced retained context and that its performance can be improved through reinforcement learning with privileged full-history distillation.
2609.35540.paper_summary_zh: 長期視野的大型語言模型（LLM）代理通常會保留其完整的互動歷史，直到在預定的閾值下觸發壓縮。我們研究了持續上下文管理（CCM），它在每次交互時進行壓縮，以防止互動歷史在活躍提示中累積。在每次交互中，CCM 代理發出一個更新的記憶體以及一個環境行動；其下一個提示包含原始任務、保留的記憶和最新觀察，而不是完整的記錄。我們首先在 TerminalBench-2 上評估未經微調的 CCM，使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6、Claude Opus 4.6、GLM-5 和 Kimi K3。CCM 顯著減少了累積的輸入使用量和活躍提示的大小，儘管它降低了大多數模型的任務成功率，但對 Kimi K3 的性能保持不變。我們使用帶有特權完整歷史蒸餾的 GRPO 來改善開放權重模型中的 CCM。一個凍結的學生初始模型副本在從該學生的回合中重建的完整歷史下對每個抽樣的學生行動進行評分，提供密集的行動標記監督，而無需單獨的教師回合或參考解決方案。在 WebShop 上，這一目標在兩個評估模型規模上顯著改善了 CCM 相較於 GRPO，並且超越了 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 的完整歷史 GRPO，但對 Qwen3-8B 則不然。在 Endless Terminals 上，增強的方法相對於 GRPO 提供了適度的改進，兩種 CCM 策略均優於未經訓練的完整歷史基線。這些結果表明，CCM 是一種可行的推理範式，適用於在大幅減少保留上下文的情況下運作的代理，並且其性能可以通過帶有特權完整歷史蒸餾的強化學習來改善。
